entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Infante Afonso of Portugal, Duke of Porto was a Portuguese Infante of the House of Braganza, the son of King Luis I of Portugal and Maria Pia of Savoy. From 1908 to the abolition of the Portuguese monarchy in 1910, he was the Prince Royal of Portugal as heir presumptive to his nephew, King Manuel II.
